label: PF Backlog 447
title: WorkerGrid Stage 3c: worker agent execution (claim -> worktree -> exec -> heartbeat -> write-back)
body:
Source: pre-implementation IMPACT review 2026-10-07 (user-approved: "Approve everything").
Authorities: docs/WORKERGRID-DESIGN.md sections 2-6 (roles/executor split/language), ADR-0002,
docs/WORKER-SCHEDULER-OPERATIONS.md (claim/lease/one-worktree-per-session IS-PF-0036),
master plan gate (paths traced, duplicates mapped).

Goal: worker agent execution loop - a new Go binary workergrid/cmd/wg-agent (invoked as `/wg agent`)
that autonomously: calls /leases/recover (reopens recovered items to queued) -> claims via coordinator
POST /work -> writes PF write-back `scheduled` -> creates an isolated git worktree on a feature branch ->
executes the configured runtime command -> heartbeats/renews lease -> writes `executing` -> `done`|`blocked`
-> releases the lease. Journal = JSONL under workergrid/state/.

IMPACT review verdicts (approved): (4) new path - agent owns its own git worktree mechanics inside
workergrid/ (git CLI, no core/vcs.py import); (6) stale - design section 4 status vocabulary
assigned/in-progress/done/blocked mapped to real PF vocabulary scheduled/executing/done(alias completed)/blocked
(doc fix in this slice); (7) new-path decision - agent owns ALL PF write-back incl. recover/reopen so a dead
worker cannot wedge an item (coordinator stays untouched; single writer for PF item status = the agent).
All other claims aligned (dependency direction, roles, no duplicate claim path, Go-first, existing route+auth).

In scope: (1) cmd/wg-agent + internal/agent loop + internal/producer status write-back; (2) config.json
`agent` block (poll_seconds, runtimes.<name>.command template with {item_id},{title},{worktree},{base_ref},
worktrees_dir, base_ref, timeout; approval_required -> blocked fail-closed); (3) /wg agent verb (exec-shim
like serve) + command md files (project + global + installed, byte-identical) + wg_surface_check verb;
(4) tests: Go unit + pytest e2e (real coordinator + agent + stub PF, command runtime = echo) wired into
wg_go_check; (5) docs: design section 14 + section 4 vocabulary fix, README, ops doc section 4-5 rewrite
(currently documents the Stage-2b-deleted /pf work flow).

Out of scope: PostgreSQL store (3b), auto-push (agent push flag default off), remote fleet orchestration,
dashboard, coordinator changes (3a stays frozen).

dashboard_impact: needs_dashboard=false - agent is an external execution-plane process; operator surface is
the /wg command + coordinator API (same rationale as BI-PF-0412).

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; precheck --full green (39 gates, 842 passed, 1 skipped); wg-go gate green (gofmt+build+vet+go test+contract parity+agent e2e 5/5); agent e2e covers happy path / failure->blocked / approval fail-closed / no-work / heartbeat-renew

decisions.decision: Stage 3c approved via IMPACT review: new worktree path inside workergrid (claim 4), agent-owned recover + PF write-back (claim 7), status-vocabulary doc fix (claim 6), full slice incl. docs/tests/gates/delivery

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_capabilities.py, core/agent_card_loader.py, core/agent_hierarchy.py, core/agent_ledger.py

_note: Stage 3c delivered: wg-agent (claim -> worktree -> exec -> heartbeat -> write-back)
